name: kneeling side to side wrist rocks
description: Hands flat with the fingers turned out to the sides, you shift your weight left and right. It moves the wrists through side bending under light load.
instructions: Kneel on all fours and turn your hands so the fingers point out to the sides.
Press your palms flat and keep your arms straight.
Shift your body slowly toward one hand, then toward the other.
Keep the heels of your hands on the floor.
Move only as far as feels comfortable.
